summary.text: Del Thompson is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-5 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Jubilee McGill.

paragraphs.text: Del Thompson also ran for the Addison-5 District in 2024 and lost the general election.
He was unopposed in the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
